blocks.text: Propositional logic computer science mein istemal hone wali logic ki ek bunyadi qism hai. Is mein aise statements (jumle) aate hain jo ya sach (true) hon ya jhoot (false). Aise statements ko propositions kehte hain (Figure 2.3 dekhein).

blocks.alt: Chaar statements, har aik teer se apni truth value tak: 2 + 3 = 5 True (sach), The sky is blue True, 1 > 3 False (jhoot), Today is Sunday False.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.3: Propositional logic ke statements (kitab ki Figure 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har statement ki sirf ek truth value hai: ya True ya False. 2 + 3 = 5 sach hai, 1 > 3 jhoot hai. “Today is Sunday” ki value din par depend karti hai: Itwar ko sach, baaqi dinon jhoot; kitab ne isay False dikhaya hai. Phir bhi har din yeh ya sach hai ya jhoot, is liye yeh proposition hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Propositional logic logic ki sab se aasan qism hai, lekin computer ki saari reasoning ki bunyad yahi hai!

Proposition aisa statement hai jo ya sach ho ya jhoot. Woh ek hi waqt mein sach aur jhoot dono nahi ho sakta. Sawal (questions) aur hukm (commands) propositions nahi hote. Maslan “Sooraj mashriq (east) se nikalta hai” ek proposition hai. Proposition ka matlab saaf hona chahiye, uljhan wala nahi. Propositions logic ki bunyadi units (sab se chhote hisse) hain. Inhi se logical expressions bante hain. Logic mein propositions ko samajhna zaroori hai. Proposition ko aam taur par bare harf (capital letter) se likhte hain, jaise P, Q ya R. Maslan agar P statement “The sky is blue” (aasman neela hai) ko dikhaye, to hum likhte hain:

Simple (saada) proposition mein sirf ek statement hota hai. Isay chhote hisson mein nahi tora ja sakta. Maslan “Barish ho rahi hai” simple proposition hai. Compound (murakkab, yani jura hua) proposition do ya zyada simple propositions ko jor kar banta hai. Inhein jorne ke liye logical connectives (jorne wale lafz) istemal hote hain. Maslan “Barish ho rahi hai aur sardi hai” compound proposition hai. Compound propositions mushkil khayalat bayan kar sakte hain aur logical reasoning mein aam hain. Propositional logic mein dono qismein aham hain.

Logical connectives woh lafz hain jo propositions ko jorte hain. AND tab istemal hota hai jab dono statements ka sach hona zaroori ho. OR tab jab kam az kam ek statement sach ho. NOT kisi statement ki sachai ulat deta hai (sach ko jhoot, jhoot ko sach). Yeh connectives compound propositions banane mein madad dete hain aur computer programs mein aam istemal hote hain. Logical connectives faisla karne mein madad dete hain (Figure 2.4 dekhein). Yeh logical expressions ko saaf banate hain, is liye inhein samajhna zaroori hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein. AND: daire A aur B, teer par A and B, 'dono A aur B sach hon to sach', aur Venn diagram jis mein sirf mushtarka hissa rangeen hai. OR: daire A aur B, teer par A or B, 'A ya B (ya dono) sach hon to sach', aur dono daire rangeen. NOT: daira A, teer par Not A, 'A jhoot ho to sach', aur A par kati lakeer.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4: Mantiqi connectives AND, OR, NOT (kitab ki Figure 2.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har line mein baayen taraf inputs A aur B hain aur daayen taraf nateeja. Venn diagram mein rang wala (hatched) hissa woh hai jahan nateeja sach hai: AND mein sirf A aur B ka mushtarka (common) hissa, OR mein dono daire poore. NOT ke liye kitab daire A par kati hui lakeer dikhati hai, yani NOT A tab sach hai jab A jhoot ho.

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaun se propositions hain? (a) Lahore Punjab mein hai. (b) Apni kitab kholo. (c) 7 even (juft) number hai.
blocks.explanation: (a) aur (c) propositions hain: (a) sach hai aur (c) jhoot, lekin dono ki ek pakki value hai. (b) hukm (command) hai, is liye proposition nahi.

items: Proposition: aisa statement jo sach ya jhoot ho, dono kabhi nahi; naam P, Q, R.
Simple: ek statement; compound: connectives se jure hue statements.
AND: dono sach hon; OR: kam az kam ek sach ho; NOT: value ulat do.
